headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for large headers. Never use generic fonts for headers.

body.usage: Use for all data tables, inputs, and general reading.

spacing_and_layout.general: Generous spacing for marketplace (p-8, p-12). High density 'Control Room' grid for admin dashboards (gap-4).
spacing_and_layout.radius: Sharp or minimal. max 8px (rounded-md) for inputs, rounded-none for large containers.
spacing_and_layout.marketplace_grid: Bento Grid style. Asymmetry in hero sections.

surface_strategies.dashboards: Grid Borders (Technical Look). Flat backgrounds, 1px subtle border, no shadow.
surface_strategies.headers: Crystal Glassmorphism: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-zinc-200/50.
surface_strategies.cards: Flat, rectangular, 1px border. On hover: -translate-y-1, shadow-lg, border color darkens.

components.buttons: High contrast. Primary: bg-[#002FA7] text-white hover:bg-[#00227A].
components.inputs: Shadcn standard, flat, 1px border. Focus state: ring-2 ring-[#002FA7].
components.maps: OpenStreetMap with Leaflet. Map style should be minimal light (e.g., CartoDB Positron tiles if possible) to match the high-contrast aesthetic.
components.tables: Dense. IBM Plex Sans font. 1px borders dividing rows, no alternating background colors. Hover state on rows.
components.charts: Recharts with brand colors. Use #002FA7 for primary metrics, #ECC94B for secondary.

motion.hover: Explicit hover states for all interactive elements. transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease.
motion.page_load: Staggered entrance animations for dashboard widgets and marketplace product grids using framer-motion.

icons.style: Duotone or Regular weight. High legibility.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn UI extensively for the control room layouts, but customize it to remove default shadows and enforce sharp edges or max 8px border-radius.
Implement Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) routing from a single single-sign-on (SSO) or login page.
Integrate Leaflet map using OpenStreetMap tiles (prefer a light minimalistic map tile source if available) for the live map view.

For the Super Admin and Warehouse Manager dashboard, implement a 'Control Room' grid layout using grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6. Make it data-dense and strictly aligned.
For the Customer Marketplace, use a 'Bento' grid style with wide gaps (gap-8) and generous padding to present products elegantly and maintain a clear path to purchase.
For the mobile-style Partner dashboards, use large typography, high contrast, and thumb-friendly interactions.
Use the provided image URLs strictly. Do not use placeholder services like via.placeholder.com.
Create high-contrast active states. Button text must be explicitly declared on hover (e.g., hover:text-white).
Ensure any sticky headers use Crystal Glassmorphism (bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl) or a solid flat border if they don't overlap content.
Always apply data-testid to critical elements for testing.
